Organize your work

Automate repetitive tasks

Instead of doing everything yourself…

you build a team that helps you do it faster.

The Tools You'll Master

We'll guide you step-by-step using:

Claude Code & Claude Cowork

The agent builder. Claude Code lets you create, deploy, and manage autonomous AI agents that execute tasks and work on your behalf. Claude Cowork works in your files and apps to handle knowledge work for you, no coding needed.

Manus

Your AI execution engine. Manus takes action: browsing the web, completing tasks, and automating workflows so your agents can work independently.

ChatGPT Agent

ChatGPT can interact with websites directly on your behalf to book appointments, create slideshows, and more, handling complex tasks from start to finish.

Base44

The no-code app builder. Build your own apps, websites, products and AI Super Agents.

n8n

The automation backbone. n8n links your apps, data, and AI models into workflows that run your business processes end to end, little to no coding required.

Note: You will need subscriptions for most tools, typically $20 – $40 per month per tool.
